display.label: Cloud SQL IAM User
display.description: A single Cloud SQL IAM database user on an existing instance, with its own lifecycle

globals.label: Project ID
globals.description: GCP Project ID that owns the parent Cloud SQL instance.

resource.key_description: Unique Terraform map key for this database user. Use the instance-user convention, for example orders-db-reporting-sa.

sections.label: User configuration
sections.description: Built-in password users are intentionally deferred until the Secret Manager write-only credential workflow is available. The parent Cloud SQL instance must already exist in this environment.

fields.label: User entry ID
fields.description: Unique key for this user entry. Use the instance-user convention, for example orders-db-reporting-sa.

validation.pattern_error: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.

fields.label: Cloud SQL instance ID
fields.description: The Cloud SQL instance this user is created on. Pick from the instances that exist in this project, or type a name if the instance is being created in the same change. The picker shows each instance's engine — it must match the engine selected below.

validation.pattern_error: Must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.

fields.label: Instance database engine
fields.description: Engine of the parent instance. MySQL requires the local email part only as the username.

fields.label: Database username
fields.description: For PostgreSQL, use the full IAM email. For MySQL, use only the local email part before @ and keep it to 32 characters or fewer.
